scope: Local artifact publication concurrency with injected memory-flush latency; not sandbox runtime or storage-throughput qualification

method.setup: Prepare 128 generations and manifests before timing
method.baseline: Same artifact store implementation with its previous root-wide exclusive flock held for the entire publication
method.updated: Shared legacy root admission plus an exclusive lock per sandbox incarnation
method.latency: Wall-clock publish_complete duration including admission wait; p95 is sorted sample index 121 of 128
method.makespan: Wall-clock time including executor startup and completion of every publication

regressions.unrelated_park_and_wake_progress_during_: Original implementation timed out waiting two seconds for unrelated cleanup; updated implementation completes cleanup and another preparation before the memory flush is released
regressions.concurrent_first_root_initialization: Passed ten repeated two-worker race tests
regressions.concurrent_128_generation_publish_load_c: Passed ten repetitions with sixteen workers

limitations: This measures elimination of an unnecessary software admission queue with tiny checkpoint files and an artificial delay.
It does not measure 128 real running sandboxes, gVisor restore, ublk, S3, CPU fairness or dirty multi-GiB memory throughput.
Real concurrent flushes still share device bandwidth; production latency and density require the live workload qualification.
